text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, the retired trainer meets
up with
Wonder Acute and me in the
runners' tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Thanks for watching me, Trainer. And...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Thank you as well.

text_block_list.name: Retired Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure was all mine, Wonder
Acute. You
were great out there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute's usual subdued brilliance
was on
full display during today's race.
But it wasn't only
that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seemed as if she had a different luster
about
her as well. She was much faster
than usual.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I heard your story. And I've been
thinking...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even Umamusume who have never met
can be
connected somehow, in some
way.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I felt something strange while I was
running
today...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It was like I could feel the emotions of
the
Umamusume you used to train with...

text_block_list.name: Retired Trainer
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute...

text_block_list.name: Retired Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for those beautiful words.
Even if
you're only saying that for my
sake.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't do that. I really mean it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I felt her, and I let her into my heart.
And I
realized that means I have no
choice but to keep
moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears as if Wonder Acute has fully
grasped
this retired trainer's
deep-seated worries.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know I can't replace your trainee, but if
you're
still okay watching me...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I promise I'll show you some great races.
As long
as you're watching.

text_block_list.name: Retired Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Then, I'll promise you
something too...

text_block_list.name: Retired Trainer
text_block_list.text:
As long as you keep running, I'll be at
the
racecourse cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what a thing to promise! But it's
very kind
of you. Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I've found such wonderful

supporters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this race over, I feel we've met the
necessary
requirements.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no longer any need for us to
make a
distinction between senior- and
classic-year
opponents. All races are on
the table.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not only that, Wonder Acute is carrying
just as
many hopes and dreams on her
shoulders as
Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From here on out, it's all up to her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll be honest with you, Trainer. I still
don't think I
can win.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That said, my goal isn't to win. I just
want to catch
up to her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think I might be just about good
enough to
reach out and grab her tail.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: But... what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's got all the gumption
necessary. As
for whether she can keep
up with Smart Falcon...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We'll just have to find out... at Oi
Racecourse in
December.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh! Do you mean it?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Finally... Finally!

うん、スマートファルコンと走ろう
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, let's run with Smart Falcon.
Yeah, let's run with Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yahoo! I'm on cloud nine!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do it, Trainer! I'll show
everyone that I
can do it...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And give them all the courage to get
back on
their feet! I swear it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our plan has been to get here through
calm,
dedicated effort, but looking back
on things...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We got here with considerable speed.
She's kept
a stiff upper lip and endured
grueling training
routines...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And thanks to that, we've kicked open
the door
to her dreams. On the other
side waits the Tokyo
Daishoten and an
incredible bout with Smart
Falcon.
